subject: Expire stale Sentinel primary-down reports before quorum checks (#4913)
reason: The change is entirely inside src/sentinel.c (sentinelCheckObjectivelyDown / sentinelAskPrimaryStateToOtherSentinels): stale SRI_PRIMARY_DOWN reports from peer Sentinels are now expired before the quorum count, in code that only executes in a process running in Sentinel mode while it monitors a primary together with other Sentinels. The fuzzer has no way to reach that code: its deployment modes are standalone and cluster only (the architecture doc lists Sentinel as an unimplemented mode), no installed experiment or component starts or drives a Sentinel, valkey.action.commands' private compare
